title: Mani Kuyil
desc: Kaveri records a video of Muthuvelu singing a song and sends it to a TV channel. Later, he becomes famous for his voice and falls in love with Kaveri.

title: Sri Bannari Amman
desc: Goddess Bannari Amman takes the form of a skilled healer, travelling through small villages to cure people's ailments. On her divine mission, she vanquishes evil and blesses the righteous.

title: Sengathu Boomiyile
desc: Vallarasu and Chinnasamy are two friends who come from closely related families. However, a fateful incident drives a wedge between them, culminating in a violent fight.

title: Kalyana Kacheri
desc: A happily married couple are forced to separate due to the growing misunderstandings between their respective family members.

title: Idhaya Veenai
desc: Sundaram, after leaving home, becomes entangled with a deceitful man, Annamalai. Falsely accused of a crime, he faces numerous challenges that test his integrity and resilience.
